name: presence-liveblocks
title: Liveblocks presence
author: Eduardo Retana
description: Liveblocks room adapter for the presence hooks. Uses @liveblocks/client and @liveblocks/react. Does not depend on the AGPL server package.

meta.descriptionEs: Adaptador de una sala Liveblocks. Los agentes son usuarios cuyo id empieza por agent-.

examples.title: Mapeo
examples.description: Ejemplo del mapeo y del cableado. No abre una sala de pago.

examples.title: Estrés
examples.description: Cero, uno y cuarenta usuarios mapeados.

api.name: useLiveblocksPresenceAdapter
api.description: Maps useOthers, useSelf, and useUpdateMyPresence. Call it inside RoomProvider.

api.name: mapLiveblocksPresence
api.description: Pure mapping used by the hook. isAgent defaults to userId.startsWith("agent-").

docs: Apache-2.0 client SDKs only. Do not add @liveblocks/server or the liveblocks CLI (AGPL-3.0). Auth with @liveblocks/node stays in the host server. The Free plan needs visible Liveblocks branding and allows 10 connections per room. See registry/lib/presence/README.md.
